description: This file defines a React component called NoteEditor, which provides a user interface for editing, previewing, saving, and deleting notes with markdown support. It manages note state via a custom store (useNotesStore) and implements features like markdown rendering, keyboard shortcuts, and confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable string using Intl.DateTimeFormat, with fallback to toLocaleString.

methods.name: escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes HTML special characters in a string to prevent injection in rendered markdown.

methods.name: mdInline
methods.description: Converts inline markdown syntax in a string to corresponding HTML tags (code, bold, italics), after escaping HTML.

methods.name: renderMarkdownToHtml
methods.description: Renders a markdown string to sanitized HTML with support for headings, bold, italics, code, and line breaks.
